title: Identification of Homeobox Transcription Factors in a Dimorphic Fungus Talaromyces marneffei and Protein-Protein Interaction Prediction of RfeB.
authors: Pongpom, Monsicha; Khamto, Nopawit; Sukantamala, Panwarit; Kalawil, Thitisuda; Wangsanut, Tanaporn
one_liner_zh: 该文鉴定马尔尼菲篮状菌中同源异型盒转录因子，并通过分子动力学模拟预测RfeB与TmSwi5的蛋白-蛋白互作，虽涉及转录因子但核心为蛋白-蛋白而非蛋白-DNA互作，方法可迁移但对象偏离。
abstract: Talaromyces marneffei is a thermally dimorphic fungus that can cause life-threatening systemic mycoses, particularly in immunocompromised individuals. Fungal homeobox transcription factors control various developmental processes, including the regulation of sexual reproduction, morphology, metabolism, and virulence. However, the function of homeobox proteins in T. marneffei has not been fully explored. Here, we searched the T. marneffei genome for the total homeobox transcription factors and predicted their biological relevance by performing gene expression analysis in different cell types, including conidia, mycelia, yeasts, and during phase transition. RfeB is selected for further computational analysis since (i) its transcripts were differentially expressed in different phases of T. marneffei, and (ii) this protein contains the highly conserved protein-protein interaction region (IR), which could be important for pathobiology and have therapeutic application. To assess the structure-function of the IR region, in silico alanine substitutions were performed at three-conserved IR residues (Asp276, Glu279, and Gln282) of RfeB, generating a triple RfeB mutated protein. Using 3D modeling and molecular dynamics simulations, we compared the protein complex formation of wild-type and mutated RfeB proteins with the putative partner candidate TmSwi5. Our results demonstrated that the mutated RfeB protein exhibited increased free binding energy, elevated protein compactness, and a reduced number of atomic contacts, suggesting disrupted protein stability and interaction. Notably, our model revealed that the IR residues primarily stabilized the RfeB binding sites located in the central region (CR). This computational approach for protein mutagenesis could provide a foundation for future experimental studies on the functional characterization of RfeB and other homeodomain-containing proteins in T. marneffei.
abstract_zh: 马尔尼菲篮状菌（Talaromyces marneffei）是一种热二态性真菌，可引起危及生命的系统性真菌病，尤其在免疫功能低下个体中。真菌同源异型盒转录因子调控多种发育过程，包括有性生殖、形态、代谢和毒力的调节。然而，同源异型盒蛋白在马尔尼菲篮状菌中的功能尚未被充分探索。在此，我们搜索了马尔尼菲篮状菌基因组中的全部同源异型盒转录因子，并通过在不同细胞类型（包括分生孢子、菌丝、酵母及相变期间）中进行基因表达分析来预测其生物学相关性。RfeB被选作进一步计算分析，因为（i）其转录本在马尔尼菲篮状菌的不同阶段差异表达，（ii）该蛋白含有高度保守的蛋白-蛋白相互作用区域（IR），该区域可能对病理生物学具有重要意义并具有治疗应用潜力。为评估IR区域的结构-功能关系，我们对RfeB的三个保守IR残基（Asp276、Glu279和Gln282）进行了计算机模拟丙氨酸替换，生成了三重RfeB突变蛋白。利用3D建模和分子动力学（molecular dynamics）模拟，我们比较了野生型和突变型RfeB蛋白与推定伙伴候选物TmSwi5的蛋白复合物形成情况。我们的结果表明，突变型RfeB蛋白表现出增加的结合自由能、升高的蛋白致密性以及减少的原子接触数量，提示蛋白稳定性和相互作用受到破坏。值得注意的是，我们的模型揭示IR残基主要稳定位于中心区域（CR）的RfeB结合位点。这种蛋白诱变的计算方法可为未来关于RfeB及马尔尼菲篮状菌中其他含同源结构域蛋白功能表征的实验研究提供基础。
